topic: 为什么古代人会把贝壳当钱？

music.prompt: 轻快但克制的纪录片配乐，弹拨乐器与轻微手鼓，纯器乐，无人声

shots.headline: 贝壳凭什么？
shots.narration: 几千年前，一枚海贝壳，真的能当钱花。
shots.caption: 海贝壳，为什么能当钱？
shots.scene: 海滩上的巨大贝壳与古代集市剪影重叠，商贩、陶罐和货物组成纸片拼贴
shots.scene_en: A gigantic engraved seashell dominates the center of a layered paper marketplace. Ancient traders, pottery jars, baskets, carts and goods surround it as separate black print cut-outs, with torn paper waves and a coastline behind them.
shots.element_motion: 纸浪轻轻起伏，一枚贝壳像主角一样滑向画面中央，报纸碎片飘动
shots.element_motion_en: Paper waves rise gently, the giant shell glides slowly toward center, and abstract newspaper scraps drift without showing readable text.
shots.palette_note: 暖黄沙滩、深蓝海色、朱红标题
shots.palette_en: warm sandy ochre, deep ocean blue, vermilion red title accent

shots.headline: 稀有
shots.narration: 首先，它足够稀有，不是走两步就能捡到。
shots.caption: 稀有：不是随处可见
shots.scene: 山路、河流和遥远海岸线组成分层地图，小人带着贝壳穿越纸片地形
shots.scene_en: A layered paper map unfolds across mountains, winding rivers, roads and a distant coastline. A tiny traveler carries one shell through the cut-paper landscape, with layered hills and a dashed route built from abstract marks.
shots.element_motion: 地图分层横向移动，纸制小人向前走，虚线路线像印章一样逐段出现
shots.element_motion_en: The paper map layers drift horizontally, the small cut-out traveler walks forward, and the abstract dashed route appears section by section.
shots.palette_note: 牛皮纸底色、墨绿路线、米白山脉
shots.palette_en: kraft paper brown, dark moss-green routes, cream-white mountains

shots.headline: 好认
shots.narration: 它还坚固、好认、容易分割，适合一次次交易。
shots.caption: 坚固、好认、方便交易
shots.scene: 特写桌面上的贝壳、谷物、陶罐和手印符号，像一张复古交易说明书
shots.scene_en: A close-up flat-lay of several distinct seashells, scattered grain seeds, a clay storage jar and abstract handprint symbols, arranged like a vintage trade guide on layered paper. Include simple arrows and circular marks, but no readable words or labels.
shots.element_motion: 贝壳、谷物和票据纸片以不同速度错位移动，半调网点轻轻脉动
shots.element_motion_en: Rigid paper shells, grain pieces and blank slips move at slightly different parallax speeds, while a simple paper arrow swings subtly into place and halftone dots pulse.
shots.palette_note: 米白纸张、黑色墨线、青色强调块
shots.palette_en: cream paper, charcoal ink lines, teal accent shapes, warm clay brown

shots.headline: 共识
shots.narration: 钱的本质，从来不是材质，而是一群人都愿意相信它。
shots.caption: 钱的本质，是共同相信
shots.scene: 贝壳变成一串符号，再连接成古代集市到现代城市的纸艺时间线
shots.scene_en: A glowing golden shell sits at the center like a shared symbol. One side becomes an ancient market cut-out, the other side becomes a modern city skyline, connected only by abstract shapes, dots and non-readable paper marks rather than lettering.
shots.element_motion: 纸艺城市和集市像折叠书页一样展开，中央贝壳稳定发光，周围纸片轻轻摇摆
shots.element_motion_en: The locked camera holds still while the market and city unfold like folding paper pages; the central shell glows steadily and nearby abstract scraps sway gently.
shots.palette_note: 深靛蓝背景、金色贝壳、红白标题块
shots.palette_en: deep indigo background, golden shell, cream paper with red and gold accent blocks
